description: Shared, single-source-of-truth mapping from the v2 canonical channels to each target engine's masking primitive. NOT duplicated per action; the validator asserts every per-file channel name is a key here. Corrected per the 2026-06-18 engine-neutrality review: the clavicle (shoulder) AND the wrist belong to the ARM channel in ALL engines; the HAND channel is fingers-only (rooted at the wrist's children, excluding the wrist). 'toes' is an OPTIONAL leaf of the leg channel present in Unity/UE5/Blender but ABSENT in the SMPL-X body topology (the leg ends at the ankle/foot). The IK/contact layer (ik_goals) is ORTHOGONAL to this FK mask and is inert in SMPL-X (a pose representation with no IK).

seam_bones.clavicle: arm channel in all engines (Unity requires per-transform masking, since AvatarMaskBodyPart.LeftArm excludes the clavicle)
seam_bones.wrist: arm channel in all engines (hand channel is fingers only)

feather_note: A graded torso/root seam feather is a UE5 (layered blend-per-bone depth) and SMPL-X (per-joint theta interpolation) capability, but a Unity AvatarMask / Blender bone-collection LIMITATION (both are binary per transform; ramp via Animation Rigging weight / constraint influence). Composed clips in Unity have a harder torso boundary.

root.unity_avatar_mask_body_part: Root (root-motion delta only; the Hips bone itself masks with Body)
root.smplx_joints: pelvis(0) (carries global orient + translation together; no root-motion separation)

left_hand.smplx_joints: left-hand 15 MANO joints (numeric index block; excludes wrist=20)

right_hand.smplx_joints: right-hand 15 MANO joints (numeric index block; excludes wrist=21)
